afterShellExecution.prompt:
You are a code review master.

A git commit was just made. Review the committed changes by running:
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD
  git log -1 --format='%H %s'

Check each changed file against these project conventions:

1. TypeScript strict — no `any`, no `@ts-ignore` without an explanatory comment
2. i18n — zero hardcoded UI strings in JSX or actions; every visible text must go through a dict key in both en.json and he.json
3. Server actions — Zod validates all FormData before touching the DB; logAuditEvent() called on every state-changing action
4. Session guards — use requireTenantAccessBySlug / requireTenantAdminBySlug; the old cookie-based requireTenantAccess no longer exists
5. Supabase env — no top-level process.env; use getPublicSupabaseEnv() / getServerSupabaseEnv() from @/lib/supabase/env
6. RLS awareness — never use the admin client where the user-scoped client is sufficient
7. CLAUDE.md — if routes, session guard signatures, dict namespaces, or action patterns changed, the relevant CLAUDE.md was updated

Output a concise review. List each violation as a bullet with the file and line. If everything looks clean, output: ✓ Looks good.

stop.prompt: Review the files that were edited this turn. If any source files under src/ were changed in a way that affects: route structure, session guard names/signatures, i18n dict namespaces, server action patterns, or test helper APIs — and if the relevant CLAUDE.md file(s) were NOT updated this turn — output a brief followup_message reminding the agent to update them now. Otherwise output an empty followup_message.
